name: Korlash Swamptron
themes: search your library for up to two Swamp cards
put them onto the battlefield tapped
equipped creature gets +1/+1 for each Swamp you control
whenever a Swamp enters, you may
plan_notes: This deck wins by suiting up Korlash, Heir to Blackblade with swamp-scaling Equipment and one-shotting opponents with commander damage, ideally by turns 6-7. The engine is simple: aggressively ramp Swamps and swamp-doublers, then land Korlash and attach Lashwrithe, Blackblade Reforged, and Nightmare Lash to make him enormous. Early turns go to mana rocks, land ramp, and tutors, while the midgame deploys Korlash with evasion and protection. Late game, you close with double strike, infect, or unblockable synergies, plus swamp-matters removal and sweepers to clear the path.
